items.text: Greetings Adventurers,
The Orc Druid Gruda Razortusk has joined the party! Control the battlefield, support your party and — when diplomacy inevitably fails — transform into a massive 2x2 bear and charge at your enemies.

notes.title: New Playable Hero: Gruda Razortusk the Orc Druid

items.text: Unlock Gruda by completing the ‘Bear Hunting’ side quest in Campaign 1 (Embers of Chaos). Once completed, the Druid becomes permanently available. The quest becomes available after you complete the first encounter in Neverwinter Wood.
We hope you enjoy the update and we can’t wait to see how you decide to play the Druid!
Keep it wild!
— The Battlemarked Team

releases.displayName: May Patch Notes (The Acquisitions Incorporated Update)

items.text: Greeting Adventurers,
The Acquisitions Incorporated update is out! This does not only include a new short adventure, but also a bunch of features, updates and fixes!

"A Golden Opportunity" - A new Short Adventure featuring Omin Dran of Acquisitions Incorporated! Play through a unique quest line alongside the events of Embers of Chaos and receive some golden rewards!
Find Omin Dran in the Emerald Tavern in Campaign 1 to start A Golden Opportunity, or if you've finished Campaign 1, you can play it as a Standalone Adventure in the selection menu.
Campaigns can now be played with varying difficulties (Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard). Previous default difficulty matches "Normal".
Campaigns can now be played with the "No Respawns" setting active. This will apply to the dungeons in the adventure (since encounters don't have respawning enemies)
Additional optional difficulty settings for all game modes are being explored for a potential future release.
"Fastness of Green Shadows" is now playable as a One Shot Dungeon.
A lot of traits have gotten new names.
Enemies attacking from fog of war will now be briefly visible to make it clearer what is going on.
Redesigned Room Browser
Added optional "focuses" to the room browser so that the host can signal intentions (like "Story", "Happy to help", "Relaxed"). Voice chat language can be explicitly set.
Added filters so players looking for a game can find one that matches their intentions
New Recently played with section added to the friends menu.
Added hover state with detailed info on status effects icons for mouse & keyboard.
Fixed cause for map marker UI miss clicks.
Added joining game loading messages.
Hide multiplayer settings during single player.
Main Menu rework
Fixed Scrap Card clipping with screen edges
Fixed status effect icons not mirroring in VR when using the opposite hand.
Campaign 2 multilevel dungeon map markers now use correct visuals.
Added laser pointer snapping to UI.
Fixed laser pointer render sorting error with hovered card.
Enemies attacking from fog of war will now be briefly visible to make it more clear what is happening.
Paladin
Divine Smite damage reduced from 7 to 6.
Cooldown increased from 1 to 2 turns.
Thunderous Smite damage increased from 7 to 8.
Wrathful Smite damage reduced from 7 to 5.
Wrathful Smite’s Frightening effect area has been increased and it should more consistently hit more targets.
Bard
Glyph of Warding can now be played on objects to protect them. Giving the object the Glyph of Warding Status Effect.
Glyph of Warding (Status Effect) - "Warded. Melee Attackers take Lightning Damage."
Glyph of Warding damage bounces between pieces instead of being a set area. This is more in line with other Lightning attacks.
Magical Secrets can now be used on enemy spell casters as well.
Fighter
Goading Attack cost reduced from 1 to 0.
Ranger
Lightning Arrow damage increased from 3 to 4.
Rogue
Poisoner's Kit - Poison Coating duration has been increased from 1 to 3 turns and damage from 1 to 3.
Stealth can be used to move up to 2 tiles, with the Rogue ending up stealthed on the indicated location.
Blinkstrike damage reduced from 10 to 8.
Sleight of Hand can now be used on most creatures.
Sorcerer
Burning Hands damage increased from 1 to 3.
General
All Psychic damage now ignores physical armor.
Traits
Combat Magic duration reduced from 3 to 1 turn.
Unflinching Focus has been changed to differentiate it from the trait Resilient. It will now reduce spell damage by 1 if the player piece is at 80% or higher health.
Enemies
All kobolds can now benefit from Kobold Pack Tactics
Kobold Pack Tactic (Status Effect) - "Deals +1 Damage and has increased Hit Chance while other Kobolds are nearby."
The Ground Pound card should no longer push around pieces meant to be immovable such as large bosses. Targets hit by it should now animate properly on impact.
Improved card playing behavior when targeting into fog of war.
Improved enemy behavior when they are acting from fog of war.
Enemies with status effects that should block them from performing certain actions should now work properly. For instance, Counterspell should now block spellcasters from using spells.
Fixed bug on non-VR platforms that could cause some NPC dialogue to not be played at an audible level, such as some of the customers in Emerald Tavern.
Fixed a bug that could cause levels with a kill enemies objectives to get confused if said target enemies got polymorphed.
When a piece is transformed such as by Polymorph, status effects already on the piece during the transformation should no longer play a notification as if reapplied.
Big pieces should now align their base plates better with the ground and clip less with the terrain.
Smoke Tiles can be removed by some other tile effects.
Fixed some missing trait trigger notifications.
Confused Enemies should no longer attack while Paralyzed.
Frightened enemies should no longer move around if they are affected by another Incapacitated Status Effect such as Sleep or Stunned.
Vicious Mockery, Bardic Inspiration, Counterspell and Disarm should not be able to target pieces if they have no effect on the target.
Uncanny Dodge and Intercepted no longer trigger at the same time.
Fire Charge trait has been fixed to better match the description.
Combat Magic now only triggers on allies.
Combat Magic is now removed when getting Downed.
Bosses and ballistae should no longer directly target player pieces that are stealthed, downed or under the effect of Sanctuary.
Non-player controllable pieces, including normally stationary ones like ballistae, should no longer be given infinite movement range when a level switches over to free movement.
Fixed bug where Magic Armor could sometimes absorb more damage than expected.
Dimension Door should transport allies more reliably.
Fixed bug that sometimes made bosses do nothing instead of taking an action.
Enjoy!
—Battlemarked Team
Greetings Adventurers! We have officially released our new hero, Azruss the Human Warlock, along with several new features in this March patch. Below is the full list of changes:
New Side quest in Campaign 2 introducing the new hero.
Warlock joins the party! Comes with new cards, traits, weapons and color options.
New One Shot Dungeon “Auril’s Cradle”, previously only playable as part of Campaign 2.

Removed Hirelings from Multiplayer. Players can assign additional custom created heroes in the party management screen. The active party is automatically set using heroes from each player. Hosts can also edit the turn order.
You can now enable/disable respawning enemies for One Shot Dungeons.

Missing a combat roll now grants your hero Tymora's Blessing. With Tymora's Blessing, next time you roll a combat roll, you will now roll two dice instead of one, and the best result of the two will count as the final result. This feature can be enabled/disabled at any time in the settings menu.
Added Italian, Portuguese (Brazilian) and Chinese (simplified and traditional) localization.

Stronger elite versions of enemies may now appear in the game, mostly in the four multi-level dungeons, both in campaign and One Shots. The details may differ, but in general elites will be noticeably tougher than their regular counterparts. For One Shots, Elite enemies will be more likely to appear on Hard and Very Hard difficulties, while not appearing at all on Easy. This replaces the enemy spam on harder One Shot difficulties.
UI fixes for better readability of UI on smaller, hand held screens like Steam Deck.
Turn order can be edited from the Party Management view in single player and multiplayer (host only).
Added Push-To-Talk support (except when using hand tracking). Enable it under the Microphone Active setting.
Added Invert Camera X Axis and Invert Camera Y Axis settings for use with game pad or mouse/keyboard.

The boss fights in One Shots will now better adapt to varying difficulties. The differences are unique for each boss fight. This can include but is not limited to changes to stats, new boss abilities and additional/stronger enemies being spawned.
Added setting to dock info boxes to the right edge of the screen on PC, PS5 and handheld.
Added setting to lock the cursor to the screen on PC.
Hide the room code in “Join room by code” menu if the show room code setting is set to “Off”.
Added texture quality setting on PC.
Moved tilt setting to controls tab on VR.
Added setting to hide laser pointers in VR.
Moving the card hand now ignores small hand movements when using hand tracking.
Added Steam virtual keyboard to SteamDeck and Steam Big Picture mode.
Some enemies can open doors and walk up the stairs.
Even more difficulty options and settings both for One Shots and Campaigns are currently in development.
Sorcerer's Weird Staff weapon line is no longer capable of teleporting non-teleportable targets such as level exits when rolling a miss.
The Deflect Magic and Unshakable Presence traits now checks if the projectile to deflect in question is tagged as a buff/heal. If it is, the the projectile will not be reflected.
The two Deflect Magic traits should now stack properly.
The Fighter weapon Battleaxe +2 now should have the intended activation rate of 20% rather than the accidental 90%.
Random encounters in multi level dungeons are now more evenly spread out.
Fixed a bug where delaying a turn would cause the next hero not to update the weapon switch cooldown nor update status effects that were supposed to update its duration on turn start.
The Bard weapons Contagious Laughter +1 and Contagious Laughter +2 could in rare instances trigger again from its own bonus damage. This has been fixed.
Cards with square shaped Area of Effects would not display the correct Area of Effect size on the card itself, or fail to display it at all. This has been fixed.
Enemies no longer follow heroes in Stealth.
Shrouding Sword should now correctly apply Stealth to allies next to the Rogue.
Several healing traits have been fixed and should now work as intended. Mainly "Potion of Healing +" should now only affect healing potions.
Cards that move the user and are meant to be playable on oneself such as the Paladin card Lay on Hands should now in fact be playable on oneself.
The Fighter card Bait and Switch should no longer be able to target the user.

Using certain cards in Non VR would fail to update the counter for how many cards you currently have in hand. This could for instance make your hand look full when it was in fact not. This has been fixed.
Merciful Reaver will no longer trigger if the attacker doesn't hit a target. And will no longer revive downed heroes.
Divine Smite + will no longer trigger if the attacker doesn't hit a target.
All Paladin weapons should now have the correct knockback melee effect.
Cards that apply a status effect that has no impact on a downed piece should no longer be playable on a downed piece.
Lay on Hands + now gives +4 healing instead of +3.
Death Ward can now revive downed heroes.
Antimagic Field status should now correctly be removed when the tile effect is removed.
Add Extra Heroes flow.
Party Manager view.
Difficulty Settings for One Shot Dungeons.
Adapt UI for a better experience in Handheld.
Shop redesign.
Added Italian, Portuguese (Brazilian) and Chinese (simplified and traditional).
Fixed missing special characters in German.

topNew: New Side quest in Campaign 2 introducing the new hero.
Warlock joins the party! Comes with new cards, traits, weapons and color options.
New One Shot Dungeon “Auril’s Cradle”, previously only playable as part of Campaign 2.

items.text: Greetings Adventurers!
The "Count Your Lucky Stars" Holiday Side Quest has officially ended as we release this February Patch. Here is a full list of changes:
Removed "Count Your Lucky Stars" Holiday Side Quest, Jollykeg and Cleepto (and all the kids of Lonelywood) say thanks!
Balancing
Vicious Mockery miss now only applies bardic inspiration for 1 turn, down from 3.
Vicious Mockery now deals 4 damage down from 5.
Glyph of Warding damage increased from 6 to 8
Song of Rest+ trait now gives +5 Magic Armor up from 1
The extra damage from the Dissonant+ trait is now one instance of damage instead of two to prevent weapon and damage effects triggering multiple times.
Bug Fixes
Save file bug where loading a multiplayer save could lead to lost hirelings is fixed.
Fixed exploit unlocking many weapons and leveling up in one-shot dungeons.
Card prices in Cleepto's Bazaar are now visible in German.
Gold removed from the player's inventory during encounters with NPC:s and the like is now updated properly.
Fixed a bug when applying Magic armor
Fixed a potential softlock when two pieces ended up dying on the same tile
Allied units no longer attack Poison Mushrooms (and various other neutral pieces).
Hypnotic Patterns targeting has been improved. The effect would sometimes not include the entire cone, making it "miss" even though targets was within the cone area.
Any bonus damage from the Rogue's weapon will no longer break Stealth if combined with a card that shouldn't break Stealth.
Fixed some weapon configurations
The Bard weapon Biting Wit no longer loses its effect shortly after being equipped.
Cards affected by the Heartstrung weapon are now correctly upgraded and the buffs to the companions now work as intended.
Improved pagination visuals
Hero select roster gamepad navigation now uses directional input instead of shoulder buttons
Customization button added to hero select podium
You can view the character sheets in the Add Secondary Hero screen in Single player
Added arrows for viewing the next character sheet when accessed through podium and party menu
Show preview of affected cards in trait selection UI
Confirmation popup when choosing to return to map on defeat
Room Codes can now be entered using number keys or pasted with Ctrl + V
Character sheets can no longer be modified while in the card shop as it could lead to bugs and unintended behavior.
Fixed exploit where VR dice could be manipulated in some scenarios
Many more minor bugs and polish fixes
Greetings Adventurers,

Today we have a new update for Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked that adds a new limited-time side quest for the holidays, the first phase of the hirelings redesign, balancing changes, and bug fixes for you!
A new side quest has been added to the game! Meet up with Dwelf Jollykeg in the Ramshackle Inn in the Crown of Frost campaign to help him with some special holiday-time deliveries.
This quest will only be available for a limited time, so play as soon as possible! For completing this quest, you will be awarded a special dice skin.
As we outlined previously, we are redesigning the hirelings system based on your feedback!
In this patch, we are implementing Phase 1 to have a single player group be composed of your own customized heroes. Experience gain will work as normal across all of the characters!

Additionally, to resolve occasional issues with hireling assignments in multiplayer games without a full party, we’re also implementing party management and quality of life improvements. You will now have the ability to reassign hirelings to players in multiplayer, and alongside this we now have the ability to change the turn order (both single and multiplayer) to facilitate specific combos easier without needing to delay the turn every time.

We’ve seen all of your requests to translate the game to Brazilian Portuguese, Italian and Simplified Chinese and are happy to confirm that these translations will be coming in the near future. Stay tuned for updates!
You can read the full, detailed patch notes here. Some of the highlight features are:
Added a brand new limited-time side quest to celebrate Simril, the festival of light. Finish the side quest for a dice reward!
You can now play with a full party of custom heroes in Single Player
Hirelings can be replaced with custom heroes in old Single Player save files
Added functionality to remove and reassign Hirelings in Multiplayer
Added functionality to change turn order while on the map
Bug fixes, performance optimization and stability improvements
Thanks for all of your feedback and reports so far. We appreciate the care and attention from the community, and will continue monitoring reports as they are made!
Much love,
—Battlemarked Team
Features
Single player uses all custom heroes instead of hirelings
One of each class of custom Heroes is automatically created when you create your first Hero. This will also happen the first time a returning player starts the game with this update.
Added a way to remove Heroes/Hirelings from the party while on the map
Old Single Player save files with Hirelings in them will load normally, please remove the Hirelings and replace them with Heroes if you want to continue that save using custom Heroes.
Added a way to adjust the turn order while on the map
Added a way to change who is controlling a Hireling in Multiplayer, both on the map and in level
The player can change/confirm their Hero's secondary ability before being able to spend trait points. This choice is still permanent.
Added a new side quest to Crown of Frost with a nice reward
Added a way to copy the multiplayer room code to more easily share it.
Side quest givers and locations are now marked with blue ! and ?
Scrapping cards in VR now has a delay to prevent accidental scrapping of cards. Additional audio has been added for both VR and gamepad when scrapping a card.
Bonfires in the Frost Keep boss fight now interact with other elements as well
You can now manually rotate and inspect unlockable dice and baseplates in the Player Profile page on flatscreen.
Achievements, unlockable dice, and unlockable baseplates now show in a more consistent order.
Improved diagonal targeting of melee attack cards with mouse and keyboard.
All cutscenes polished and improved (more changes than you can count on your fingers and toes combined!)
Try out the new side quest by going to the Ramshackle Inn, and speak to Jollykeg to start it.
New card added as part of the new quest line!
Complete the quest and receive the reward!
Overall Stability improvements
General performance improvements
Fixed a bug where text would not update properly sometimes when you change languages while in the shop
Trait point notifications on the party menu will be hidden after viewing that character sheet, until the next level up

notes.title: Fixed bugs related to the 'Confused' Status Effect

items.text: Confused units now only attack when adjacent to a target
They can't attack while incapacitated (stunned, sleep, etc.)
Fixed a bug where the final boss of 'Crown of Frost' sometimes dealt damage to himself (stupid!)
Fixed a bug where boss levels of dungeons would sometimes not appear when playing a dungeon a second time in a session
Ice Troll Heart now always works correctly on targets other than yourself
Potion of Speed VFX now always plays on the correct target when used on others, and also uses the correct animation.
If a Hero possesses multiple traits that activate when reviving an ally, all of them will trigger properly now.
All forms of healing that revives a downed hero should now trigger traits that activates when reviving an ally.
Fixed a bug where 'Prismatic Spray' cards could sometimes disappear from your hand as you progressed through the game if you did not have the trait Prismatic Spray+.
'Lunging Attack' and other similar attacks used by enemy units such as wolves should no longer displace the attacker.
The 'Honed Instinct' trait now works as intended, and the trigger chance has been changed to 10%.

The 'Merciful Reaver +2' weapon previously had a 10% chance to activate its effects, which was an unintended downgrade. This has been changed to always trigger to match the other versions of Merciful Reaver.

'Honed Instinct', 'Double Tap', and 'Extra Attack' traits now operate independently rather than stacking, meaning if you have several of the traits you can get multiple follow up melee attacks if you are lucky. Furthermore, many of the melee attack cards can now trigger the traits.

The 'Warborn Surge' trait now only applies to non-props on the same team. Furthermore, it should now trigger for any type of melee attack, rather than just the basic melee attack and a select few cards.
Both 'Combat Magic' traits should now stack properly. The associated status effect icon has also been updated.
Hello Adventurers! We're thrilled to release our second patch. Here is a full list of changes:
Network stability fixes
Performance improvements - less stuttering and lag overall
Fixed crashes that would sometimes occur on PS5
Fixed a bug where the Card Shop could sometimes clip into elements of the environment in VR
Fixed many bugs related to Polymorph
Polymorph status effect no longer remains when the creature reverts form

Pieces that spawn with status effects (like the Troll's Regeneration or the Frost Giant's Cold Aura) don't carry that status effect over when transforming, but regain it when reverting to their original form
Polymorphed Heroes now get the Polymorphed status effect
Large enemies now consistently get the Polymorphed status effect when transformed, regardless of which tile you targeted to Polymorph them
Heroes that are downed can no longer be targeted by Polymorph
Status effects on a timer that were on you before transforming, and that expire while you're transformed, no longer reappear when you revert form
The Polymorph status effect now properly reverts your form when it's removed
If you enter Cleepto's Bazaar while Polymorphed, we now display your original hand and piece instead of the rat's view and hand. Cleepto always knows your true form!
Trait cards are no longer granted multiple times when Polymorphed or reverting from being Polymorphed
Cards can now upgrade properly if you select a trait that upgrades a card while you're Polymorphed
Cards now countdown through their cooldown properly when Polymorphed (both for your current rat form, as well as your original form)
Fixed a bug where some enemies could target units that were in Stealth with Disarm, Counterspell, Hunters Mark, Quick Grapple and Throw
Fixed a bug where the Repeating Ballista could sometimes attack units that are friendly or in Stealth
Applying traits that increase max HP will not longer grant HP to downed heroes
Fixed a bug where Cordon of Arrows sometimes wouldn't deal damage
Fixed a bug where Vicious Mockery sometimes wouldn't ignore armor
Battle Hardened now properly protects against counter attacks
The effect from the Bard weapon, Biting Wit, no longer causes friendly fire
Props such as barricades and barrels can no longer be affected by upgraded Bardic Inspiration or Crushed
Certain attacks such as Disarm should no longer be able to target units that are in Stealth or protected by Sanctuary
Banish no longer works on bosses
The Leap card no longer leaves a lasting trail on the piece after the action has been completed
Fixed a bug where gold would sometimes be invisible
Fixed a bug where Achievement notifications would linger on screen in VR
Players that join an ongoing session while others are in Cleepto's Bazaar can start shopping immediately. Any replaced hirelings are correctly removed, so the host doesn't need to shop for them.
Fixed a bug where the camera could get stuck in the Desecrated Shrine, making dice rolling harder in flatscreen
Slightly increased wait time when searching for friends to lessen load on servers
Fixed a gamepad bug where changing previewed card hand while holding a card on the board could leave the camera locked
Fixed a gamepad bug where the 'skip cutscene' button would sometimes be unresponsive
Fixed a gamepad bug where skip input sometimes was ignored
Fixed a bug that caused the last 'Waiting for Player' icon to overlap the 'skip cutscene' button in flatscreen
Fixed incorrect tutorial message about scrapping cards using gamepad
Fixed numerous typos across the game
Fixed a bug where Chief Blaze would still attack after being defeated in the Emerald Tavern bar brawl
Fixed a bug where the party sometimes would not gain XP from defeating Frostmourn Raknar
Fixed a bug where the Wayfarer achievement couldn't be unlocked
0 AP actions now counts towards the 'Time Stop' Achievement properly
Fixed a bug that could cause progression blockers when joining a session just as a dungeon or campaign has been completed, or if players left during when the popup was visible
Fixed a bug where the quest marker would not function properly in the 'Quiet the Jarl' and 'King's Tears' quests
It should be possible to hand in Nimsy's quest after defeating the final boss of Crown of Frost
Isteval should no longer ask you to go to Frost Keep after defeating the final boss of Crown of Frost
Fixed a rare bug that could cause a piece to be displaced outside of the board, leading to various issues
When the key is found in Cragmaw Castle, the prisoner is highlighted to show players where to go next
Forgotten Cairn has fewer skeletons
Blaze conversation in Loggers' Camp now only requires one player to make choices, instead of votes
Added instructions on how to tilt the table in the VR settings menu
General UI polish
VO and sound effect polish and adjustments
VFX polish
Hello Adventurers!
We've been working hard to fix some issues that have been reported during the launch week. While some issues still remain, rest assured we're working on those too!
Please update your game to the latest version for uninterrupted multiplayer.
Fixed a bug where cards could sometimes get scrapped unintentionally in VR
Improved server stability to prevent random disconnects
Fixed a bug that would cause performance to deteriorate during long play sessions
Fixed a bug that could cause players to lose progression
Fixed a bug where Achievements would sometimes not unlock dice correctly
Added confirmations for 'Retreat to map' and 'Quit Game' buttons
Changed the UI for 'Send Bug Report' button to make it clearer

notes.title: Changed the UI for loading of saved games

items.text: Changed the 'Load Game' button to 'Continue', which opens up a list of saved games
'Continue' is now listed as the first option for better visibility
We're grateful for your patience as we continue to improve the game. We will be sharing more information about design changes related to hirelings very soon!
Improved multiplayer stability, which also resolved unexpected soft locks that sometimes occurred in games. Those games can now be resumed.
Fixed an issue where system language settings could lead to text in the game sometimes disappearing.

We have a quick update note for you today, adventurers! Through some crafty lockpicking skills, the padlock icon has been removed from Tharok, the dwarven fighter, and this character is now available to play in the demo!
